name: design-studio-mulesoft
description: A fast designer for Anypoint Design Center API specs, RAML and OAS, inside VS Code. Every edit is checked by AMF as you type, and it syncs with Design Center and Exchange.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_get_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: What Design Studio has open (project, root file, files, unsaved files, open tabs), recent projects, who is signed in to Anypoint, and whether changes in Design Center and Exchange are allowed for AI tools. Call it first.
languageModelTools.userDescription: What Design Studio has open (project, root file, files, unsaved files, open tabs), recent projects, who is signed in to Anypoint, and whether changes in Design Center and Exchange are allowed for AI tools.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_open_project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a spec project folder on this computer (a path from get_state recentProjects, or any folder). If the open project has unsaved changes, Design Studio asks the person first.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a spec project folder on this computer (a path from get_state recentProjects, or any folder).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_create_project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new API specification or fragment project, as Design Center's Create does, and open it. With in_design_center it is created in Design Center too (needs changes allowed and a sign-in that isn't read only).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new API specification or fragment project, as Design Center's Create does, and open it.

in_design_center.description: Also create it in Design Center (default false)

secured.description: Start from the secured starter (raml, oas3yaml, oas3json, oas31yaml, oas31json, asyncyaml, asyncjson): an Orders API with HTTPS only, OAuth 2.0 on every call, error and rate-limit responses and correlation ids, clean on MuleSoft's best-practice and OWASP rulesets. Rename it to the person's API (default false)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_close_project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Close the open project and go back to the start screen (asks the person if files are unsaved).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Close the open project and go back to the start screen (asks the person if files are unsaved).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_list_files
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Every file in the open project, the root file, and which are unsaved. Files under exchange_modules/ are Exchange dependencies and are read only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Every file in the open project, the root file, and which are unsaved.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: A file's text as the editor holds it (unsaved edits included). Paths are relative to the project, with forward slashes.
languageModelTools.userDescription: A file's text as the editor holds it (unsaved edits included).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_write_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a file or replace its whole text, then save it. It opens in the editor so the person sees it. Prefer edit_file for changes to an existing file: it keeps the rest byte for byte.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a file or replace its whole text, then save it.

path.description: File path in the project; folders are made as needed

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_edit_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace an exact piece of text in a file and save it. old_text must match exactly once (include enough surrounding lines), unless replace_all is true. Indentation is YAML structure in RAML and OAS: keep it right.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Replace an exact piece of text in a file and save it.

replace_all.description: Replace every match instead of exactly one

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_delete_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a file to the Recycle Bin or Trash (it can be restored from there).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Move a file to the Recycle Bin or Trash (it can be restored from there).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_rename_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename or move a file. Every !include and uses: path that points at it is updated, as Design Center does.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename or move a file.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_set_root_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Make a file the project's root file (Design Center's Set as root file; written to exchange.json).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Make a file the project's root file (Design Center's Set as root file; written to exchange.json).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_show_in_editor
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a file in the editor for the person, optionally at a line.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a file in the editor for the person, optionally at a line.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_check_spec
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run AMF's full check (the same engine and rules as Design Center) on the project, unsaved edits included. Returns every error and warning with file and line. Run it after every change and fix what it reports until it is clean.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run AMF's full check (the same engine and rules as Design Center) on the project, unsaved edits included.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_get_outline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The API as a tree: resources and their methods, types, traits, resource types, security schemes and libraries, with the file each is declared in.
languageModelTools.userDescription: The API as a tree: resources and their methods, types, traits, resource types, security schemes and libraries, with the file each is declared in.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_find_references
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Where a type, trait, resource type or security scheme is declared and used, in every file (Design Center's Go to References). Library members are written alias.Name.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Where a type, trait, resource type or security scheme is declared and used, in every file (Design Center's Go to References).

name.description: The name, like Order or lib.Order

file.description: Optional: the file you see the name in, for library aliases

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_rename_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename a type, trait, resource type or security scheme and every use of it in every file (Design Center's Rename), never plain mentions in descriptions.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename a type, trait, resource type or security scheme and every use of it in every file (Design Center's Rename), never plain mentions in descriptions.

name.description: Current name (alias.Name for a library member)

file.description: Optional: the file you see the name in

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_convert_spec
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Convert a RAML root file to OAS with AMF (Design Center's Duplicate As) and save the result as a new file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Convert a RAML root file to OAS with AMF (Design Center's Duplicate As) and save the result as a new file.

target_path.description: Where to save the converted file

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_type_as_json_schema
languageModelTools.displayName: Design Studio: Type as json schema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: A RAML type or OAS schema rendered by AMF as JSON Schema.
languageModelTools.userDescription: A RAML type or OAS schema rendered by AMF as JSON Schema.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_type_as_raml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: A type (an OAS schema, say) rendered by AMF as a RAML 1.0 data type, as a library.
languageModelTools.userDescription: A type (an OAS schema, say) rendered by AMF as a RAML 1.0 data type, as a library.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_validate_payload
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check a sample body (JSON, YAML or XML) against a declared type with AMF's payload validator, the check the mock and API Manager apply. Returns conforms and the problems, each with a JSON path. Unsaved edits count.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check a sample body (JSON, YAML or XML) against a declared type with AMF's payload validator, the check the mock and API Manager apply.

file.description: The file that declares it (optional when the name is unique)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_run_governance
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check the API against the governance rulesets it depends on (Exchange rulesets in exchange.json), as Design Center's Governance does. Returns each finding with its rule, level and place.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check the API against the governance rulesets it depends on (Exchange rulesets in exchange.json), as Design Center's Governance does.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_mock_request
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call the API's local mock (Design Center's mocking service, unsaved edits included) and get the status, headers and body it answers with. Supports Design Center's MS2-Status-Code and MS2-Example headers.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Call the API's local mock (Design Center's mocking service, unsaved edits included) and get the status, headers and body it answers with.

path.description: Path with query, like /orders/1?limit=2 (the baseUri path is not needed)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_design_center_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The open project's Design Center link: project, branch, whether Design Center has commits not pulled yet, who holds the lock, and the local changes not pushed yet.
languageModelTools.userDescription: The open project's Design Center link: project, branch, whether Design Center has commits not pulled yet, who holds the lock, and the local changes not pushed yet.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_pull
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Bring Design Center's latest commits in, merging with local changes (like git). Conflicting lines get both versions between markers, to resolve with edit_file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Bring Design Center's latest commits in, merging with local changes (like git).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_push
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save every file and send the local changes to Design Center, holding the branch lock. Refuses when Design Center has commits not pulled yet (pull first).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save every file and send the local changes to Design Center, holding the branch lock.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_list_branches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The Design Center project's branches.
languageModelTools.userDescription: The Design Center project's branches.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_switch_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Switch the project to another Design Center branch (local changes must be pushed or discarded first).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Switch the project to another Design Center branch (local changes must be pushed or discarded first).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_create_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a Design Center branch from the current one and switch to it.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a Design Center branch from the current one and switch to it.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_list_design_center_projects
languageModelTools.displayName: Design Studio: List design center projects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The Design Center projects in the signed-in organization (Design Center's project list).
languageModelTools.userDescription: The Design Center projects in the signed-in organization (Design Center's project list).

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_pull_design_center_project
languageModelTools.displayName: Design Studio: Pull design center project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Pull a Design Center project to this computer (or find the copy already here) and open it.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Pull a Design Center project to this computer (or find the copy already here) and open it.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_publish_to_exchange
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Publish the project to Exchange (Design Center's Publish): pushes unsent changes first, holds the lock, publishes, pulls back exchange.json. A Stable version can't be published twice; use development for a version you will republish.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Publish the project to Exchange (Design Center's Publish): pushes unsent changes first, holds the lock, publishes, pulls back exchange.json.

development.description: Publish as a Development version (default false: Stable)

api_version.description: API version, like v1 (default from the spec)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_org_dashboard
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The signed-in organization's APIs at a glance (the Dashboard): every Exchange asset with its latest version, who published it and when, whether API Governance is on, and each governed API's conformance (rulesets passing and failing). Read only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: The signed-in organization's APIs at a glance (the Dashboard): every Exchange asset with its latest version, who published it and when, whether API Governance is on, and each governed API's conformance (rulesets passing and failing).

org_id.description: A business group id (default: the signed-in organization)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_conformance_report
languageModelTools.modelDescription: One governed API's API Governance report: each ruleset passed or failed, and each failing rule with its message and the place in the spec. Take the urn from org_dashboard.
languageModelTools.userDescription: One governed API's API Governance report: each ruleset passed or failed, and each failing rule with its message and the place in the spec.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_search_exchange
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search Exchange for assets to depend on: RAML fragments (libraries, types, traits), rulesets, or APIs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search Exchange for assets to depend on: RAML fragments (libraries, types, traits), rulesets, or APIs.

types.description: Asset types, like raml-fragment, rest-api, ruleset (default raml-fragment)

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_asset_versions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: An Exchange asset's versions, newest first, with Stable or Development status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: An Exchange asset's versions, newest first, with Stable or Development status.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_add_dependency
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add an Exchange asset as a dependency (Design Center's Exchange dependencies): written to exchange.json and fetched into exchange_modules/. Returns the path to use in !include or uses:.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add an Exchange asset as a dependency (Design Center's Exchange dependencies): written to exchange.json and fetched into exchange_modules/.

languageModelTools.name: designStudio_remove_dependency
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove an Exchange dependency (refused while a file still uses it).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Remove an Exchange dependency (refused while a file still uses it).

scripts.verify: node scripts/files-verify.mjs && node scripts/renew-verify.mjs && node scripts/mcp-verify.mjs
